title: Personalized kinematic constraint-based drift correction for 3D golf swing trajectory monitoring with a wrist-worn IMU

creators.name: Park, Guen-a
creators.affiliation: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

description: MATLAB and Python code for reconstructing the three-dimensional wrist trajectory of a golf swing from a single wrist-worn inertial measurement unit, using a subject-specific kinematic constraint obtained once from monocular video and thereafter inferred from the IMU signals alone.
